meta.dataset: Indicative available soil water capacity by texture
meta.units: mm water per m soil depth
meta.source: FAO Soil and Water, Chapter 2, Table 8 (adapted from Salter and Williams 1967)
meta.notes: Values are typical and vary with soil structure and management. They are not a substitute for a local soil test; absent calibrated root depth and field capacity data, the app does not convert a sensor moisture percentage into stored water.

fao56TypicalValues.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Table 19
fao56TypicalValues.verificationStatus: FAO56_PUBLISHED_RANGES; defaults are arithmetic midpoints of published ranges, not field measurements
fao56TypicalValues.notes: Typical defaults use the midpoint of each FAO-56 range. Clay loam is not a Table 19 class and is left unavailable rather than mapped to a different texture. Farmer overrides are recommended when local measurements exist.
